scope: Fresh static disassembly and metadata/type resolution for the installed official client Ammo/EventCounter maximum-count modifier path. No game execution or runtime XLua override verification.

tool.writePolicy: Only this evidence JSON was written; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

symbols.A: sum of all Dictionary<uint,int> values at skill +0x178
symbols.P: sum of all Dictionary<uint,float> values at skill +0x180

confirmedFormula.general: maxCount = max(1, M + A + RoundEven(B * P))
confirmedFormula.ordinaryInitialization: AbilityEventCounter.SetData reads trigger_time or another_trigger_time into m_maxCount, then copies it to m_originalMaxCount, so M = B in this initialization path. The familiar max(1, B + A + RoundEven(B * P)) is the ordinary specialization, not a proof that M and B can never differ.
evaluationOrder: Sum percentage modifiers using addss float32 arithmetic.
Convert B to float32 and multiply by the summed percentage using mulss.
Convert that float to FP32.32 via float32 multiplication by 2^32 and truncation to the raw integer.
MathUtil.RoundToInt calls FP.Round, which rounds half cases to an even integer, then FP.AsInt.
Add the summed fixed additions after the proportional portion has been rounded.
Store this sum as m_maxAdditionCount; get_maxCount returns max(1, m_maxCount + m_maxAdditionCount).
confirmedFormula.notAttributeFormula: Fixed additions do not enter the percentage multiplication. Percentage contributions are added before the single rounding step, rather than independently rounded or multiplied together.

confirmedSourceProtocol.identity: Both modifier dictionaries are keyed by Buff.instanceUid (uint).
confirmedSourceProtocol.replacement: SetMaxAdditionCount and SetMaxAdditionCountPercent call ContainsKey and then either Add or set_Item. A repeated registration for the same Buff UID replaces that dictionary value; it is not another accumulated source.
confirmedSourceProtocol.zeroRestore: AmmoSkillCountModifier.get_addMaxCount is modifyMaxCount && !restoreMaxCount; restore enters the corresponding setter with zero. This leaves a zero entry rather than proving physical dictionary removal.
confirmedSourceProtocol.affectingBoundary: After setting an entry, each setter invokes the virtual get_isAffecting path (BasicSkill slot 26; observed vtable entry at +0x2e0). It calls _UpdateMaxAdditionCount only if that returns false. While affecting, registration changes alone do not immediately replace the current counter addition.
confirmedSourceProtocol.counterSampling: _FetchCounterSource returns when a valid current counter already exists. After an absent or invalid reference, fetching or binding a counter calls _UpdateMaxAdditionCount; this does not prove the bound instance has a fresh identity. OnTick calls _FetchCounterSource; this is not unconditional per-Tick recomputation.
confirmedSourceProtocol.scopeLimit: These selected ordinary native paths establish the data formula and registration protocol. Actual content may select different counter sources or use other operations; no runtime hotfix bodies were validated.

instructionAnchors.meaning: Integer dictionary enumeration adds each value to fixed-addition sum.
Float dictionary enumeration adds each value to percentage sum.
Multiply float32 B by summed percentage.
Add fixed sum after the rounding call.
Read m_maxAdditionCount, add m_maxCount, clamp to at least one.
At an exact half, bit 32 selects parity of the integer portion.

derivedWitnesses.limitation: Arithmetic consequences of decoded instructions, not results from running an official battle.

cases.distinction: Fixed +2 is not multiplied; (10+2)*1.5 would give 18.
Sum ratios first; independently rounding the two 0.5 contributions would incorrectly give 10.
General formula separates current base M from original proportional base B; this is an illustrative state, not an actual content witness.

directCallsToPercentSetter.limitation: Direct E8 calls only. Indirect calls and runtime XLua calls are not enumerated.
